"""Date helpers for ISO-format dates (YYYY-MM-DD)."""

from datetime import date


def days_between(a, b):
    """Return the number of days from date ``a`` to date ``b``.

    Both arguments are ISO date strings (``YYYY-MM-DD``).  The result is
    negative when ``b`` is earlier than ``a``.  Leap years are handled by
    the standard library's proleptic Gregorian calendar.
    """
    start = date.fromisoformat(a)
    end = date.fromisoformat(b)
    return (end - start).days
